_comment: Second Genie meeting (Level 2, Place 3). Triggered when Aladdin approaches the second lamp near his spawn in Place 3. Genie teaches the apple-throwing mechanic (the projectile logic itself is not yet implemented — only the dialogue).
title: Second Meeting

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Listen carefully, this will help you survive.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: The lamp is responding to danger… it's unlocking a hidden trick.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Press "P" and you'll enter a special mode… call it an apple fight if you like.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: In that state, you can throw apples at your enemies.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: They may look simple… but they hit much harder than anything else you have.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Use it when you're overwhelmed… or when something refuses to fall.
